content: Hi there! Let me know how I can assist with your rent payment tracking or any other account details. Our records from last month are ready for review if needed.
I just want to double-check that my part of the April rent got processed. I sent $1,050 through Venmo last Friday using your handle @WestonAptManager, and I wrote my name, Lisa Torres, in the note.

Thank you, Lisa. I can confirm a Venmo payment of $1,050 was received on April 21. The transaction reference is VEN-5243982. Since you included your name in the note, your payment is logged under Unit 4B.
Perfect. My brother Sam Torres will be sending his half today, too. He might use Zelle instead, will that be an issue?

No issues at all, Zelle transfers to our account ending in 8637 are accepted. Please remind Sam to include 'Unit 4B, April rent' in the memo for instant processing, as payments received before 6 PM are posted same-day.
Thanks, I'll let him know. What's the exact amount he should send?
Sam should send $1,050 to match your half for April. If he needs confirmation, he can reference email westonleasing@buildingmail.com or SMS to 555-214-0991 once he submits the payment.
Great, I'll forward those details to him now.

Much appreciated, Lisa. Both payments will appear on the next monthly statement, and a receipt will be sent to lisatorres23@gmail.com and Sam's on file as soon as processing completes. Let me know if there's anything else you need before 6 PM today to ensure timely posting.
